name: Oholiab
title: The Tabernacle's Artisan
summary: Oholiab was the son of Ahisamach from the tribe of Dan and was chosen by God together with Bezalel to lead the construction of the tabernacle. He was especially gifted with artistic skills in weaving, embroidery, and engraving, and served as a teacher for other craftsmen.

keyEvents.title: Chosen by God as a Craftsman
keyEvents.description: God appointed Oholiab by name to work alongside Bezalel on the tabernacle and filled him with wisdom and understanding in all kinds of craftsmanship.

keyEvents.title: Gifted with Special Artistic Abilities
keyEvents.description: Oholiab received the ability to perform engraving, weaving, and embroidery in blue, purple, and crimson wool and fine linen.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as a Teacher
keyEvents.description: God gave Oholiab the ability to teach others in craft skills so that many could contribute to the construction of the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Worked on the Holy Place's Articles
keyEvents.description: Together with Bezalel, Oholiab carried out all the work that the Lord had commanded for the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: Completed the tabernacle
keyEvents.description: Under the leadership of Oholiab and Bezalel, the tabernacle, along with all its fabrics, coverings, and artistic decorations, was completed according to God's instructions.
